pages.title: Mustang
pages.text: A free-roaming North American horse - tough, weatherproof, and rarely the same coat twice.

pages.title: Wild Instincts
pages.text:
A horse that lived feral notices what a stabled one misses.

**Hostile alert.** Anything hostile within **15 blocks** - through walls, in the dark - gets an angry snort and a **glowing outline for 3 seconds**. You hear that something is there, and you see where.

**Self-sufficient.** It heals steadily on its own, with no hay or apples needed.
